profile.headline: Interested in a Software Engineer II position in which I can fully utilize my MSCS and previous experiences at Dell Technologies to help bringing new products to market with high quality in my new role.
profile.summary:
Interested in a Software Engineer II position in which I can fully utilize my MSCS and previous experiences at Dell Technologies to help bringing new products to market with high quality in my new role.  

Projects:
1.	Big data project: Data analysis using Kafka and neo4j running on Kubernetes upon the taxicab dataset.
2.	Cloud computing project: implemented a video facial recognition service to users, utilizing Amazon AWS cloud services as well as a Lambda function with FFmpeg to extract individual frames from the videos provided by the users. Updates to the S3 input and output buckets will be monitored by OpenStack and the Lambda function will be called from OpenStack.
3.	Convolutional neural network: built a convolutional neural network (CNN) using Keras, a deep learning framework, to perform the classification task.  Client: Android Mobile Application; backend server: Flask.
4.	Attack vectors on modern cryptographic schemes and Implementations.
5.	A three-tier architecture comprising web, application, and data tiers, all of which were hosted on AWS.  Apache webserver was used to host the web and application tier components, while the data tier was comprised of a PostgreSQL database and Hyperledger blockchain.  The framework used for the backend development of the application is Spring Boot, which is coded in Java. Spring Boot has an excellent performance in application security.
6.	Directional stock prediction using news and historical price data.
7.	Using facial recognition for payment applications and blockchain for preserving the authenticity of the ledger

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
* Worked on continuation of last summer’s project "a storage workload for backup replication automation in Python" as team lead
  + For ease of use, the customer workload profiles generated from last summer’s project were presented within a website
  + Project produced industry-level aggregated profiles and characterized each industry
  + Using SSH, could run profiles directly on a testing server and get the response time curves per industry
* Data provided to project changed to
  + Adapted previous work to suit new data
* Completed the pipeline from raw data to EMCmark run results
* Added various other features to EMCmark such as skew data
* Organized and ran daily team meetings

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
* Worked on a storage workload for replication automation project in Python
     + Customer workload replication done manually consumes considerable time and effort or requires a large amount of data to be stored, which is expensive
     + Automated this manual process resulted in faster data collection, analysis, and engineering
productivity
     + Characterized the data (IO type distribution, IO size, etc.)
     + Compressed the required storage into two forms:
         * trained machine learning model, which could then generate new representative IO
         * set of IO test tool config files to represent the workload
* Implemented the main control flows and functions to interface with the IO testing tools fio and EMCmark
* Handled most preprocessing, including aggregation, scaling, cleaning, and computation of workload attributes
* Used data sourced from CloudIQ in CSV format
    + Output could be config file used to replay data, config file representing most common workload, or analysis of the data
    + Options:
        * select only certain storage groups or storage arrays
        * aggregate the data from storage groups or storage arrays selected
        * cycle through the data with various scaling factors
        * compress the time necessary to replay the data
 + All data manipulations in preprocessing
        * Resultant Pandas dataframe easy to generate IO config files for other IO test tools
positions.insights: Machine Learning, Cloud Computing and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
* Worked on automating test management tool migration to qTest
     + Wrapped qTest REST API endpoints
     + Coded a significant portion of the main scripts using those endpoints
* Part of Dell’s North Star initiatives:
* Tools were migrated to a single standardized tool
     + For test management tool was qTest
     + The project avoids manual migration by using qTest APIs in Python scripts to automatically
migrate the data and save more than 60 man-person hours.
